text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Bamboo Memory,
who hasn't been in top form lately.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So I don't disrespect the gods,
I studied shrine visiting etiquette thoroughly beforehand!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up, Trainer!
First, when you walk down the shrine approach—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...W-Where was I supposed to walk again!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Which hand holds the water ladle...?
The chopstick hand? No, the rice bowl hand...?!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I know this one!
When you pray, you ring the bell 108 times, right?!
choice_data_list: Isn't it two bows, two claps, one bow...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh!! It's not working at all!!
Even though I totally slept with the etiquette book as my pillow last night...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I bet even God is fed up with me...
choice_data_list: I'm sure your earnest feelings are getting through.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's true, when it comes to sheer determination,
I'm confident I won't lose to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gods...!! Please accept
my burning passion...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright! We did everything we could!
All that's left is to give it our absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! My body suddenly feels so light!
It must've been a divine blessing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go thank the gods!
Next time, so I don't be disrespectful,
I'll study proper shrine etiquette before the torii gate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bamboo Memory successfully
regained her top condition.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's suddenly pouring down!
Is this payback for me being rude?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Bamboo Memory's feelings failed to reach her,
and she struggled to get back into top form for some time after.
